feeds.title: The Vinyl Factory
feeds.description: The Vinyl Factory is the world's foremost vinyl enterprise. It encompasses a record label, pressing plant and online magazine, and collaborates with artists and musicians to create stunning audio-visual shows.

feeds.title: The Vinyl District
feeds.description: Weekly, TVD features well-considered reviews, live performance coverage, as well as vinyl and ticket giveaways from the largest international acts to the smallest 'you should get to know' bands. Interviews range from industry legends to emerging artists. The Vinyl District is your daily brick and mortar, indie record store fix.

feeds.title: The Pirates Press Record of the Week Blog
feeds.description: Pirates Press is the best source for independent musicians, artists and entrepreneurs looking to manufacture top quality packaged vinyl records & CDs, as well as merchandise and promotional devices without having to pay top dollar.

feeds.title: Recordmecca Blog
feeds.description: Fine music collectibles from Recordmecca. Recordmecca buys and sells the finest rare records and music memorabilia.

feeds.title: Sound Matters Blog
feeds.description: Sound Matters is here to regain a more authentic music experience in the digital age. We believe in the vinyl format as the best way to own music. We help you get the most amazing sound and experience from your vinyl records.

feeds.title: Classical33.co.uk Blog
feeds.description: Bringing you a massive collection of Great Records and CDs Classical33.co.uk is a UK-based Mail Order Vinyl Records and CDs music shop offering a broad range of genres. We are an independent retailer and sell exclusively online.

feeds.title: Rock On Vinyl
feeds.description: Articles on vinyl records by an Australian Systems Manager.

feeds.title: vinyldiscovery
feeds.description: I'm Tom Skipper. This is a blog about the adventure of searching for classic vinyl LPs and a discussion of albums and artists and how disks came to be in my collection.

feeds.title: The Vinyl Press
feeds.description: I'm Bill Hart. I'm treating this whole website as a process of exploration. I have access to a considerable pile of vinyl that I have accumulated over the course of more than 45 years. One section of this site is dedicated to record cleaning and care. I consider this an essential part of buying older records.

feeds.title: Deep Groove Mono
feeds.description: Deep Groove Mono is a music collecting blog designed, developed, written, and maintained independently by Richard Capeless. Deep Groove Mono aims to provide collectors with unprecedented resources related to their hobby, and to document the author's collecting experience. Deep Groove Mono focuses on jazz, doo-wop, rhythm & blues, and country blues originally released the LP, 45, and 78 formats.

feeds.title: blog.eil.com
feeds.description: Record Collecting Vinyl & CD New, Rare, Reissue & Box Set News. We buy & sell premium quality rare & new vinyl records, LPs, albums 7, 12 singles, CDs, CD singles & music memorabilia.

feeds.title: The One Thing That Still Holds True
feeds.description: I'm Mike. Music is my passion. I need it at all times. The influence it has had on me is undeniable. My record collection is much more than wax and cardboard. It is who I am. This documentation captures new additions to my collection.

feeds.title: Sly Vinyl
feeds.description: We are your record Informant. Giving you the inside scoop on pre-order, limited, special edition and small run records & vinyl.

feeds.title: Flea Market Funk
feeds.description: Flea Market Funk is Jersey City, NJ-based blog and lifestyle web portal focusing on collecting and DJing Funk, Soul, Jazz, Hip Hop and Reggae music on vinyl.

feeds.title: Vinyl Record Life
feeds.description: Hi, my name's Joe and this is my blog about all things vinyl. I've been collecting records for a number of years now, after inheriting an incredible collection from my dad. I've learned a lot about records, turntables/record players and all things audiophile along the way, and continue to do so. I want to share all that information here on my blog for you to benefit from too!

feeds.title: Vinyl Bro Blog
feeds.description: At Vinyl Bro we love music. Our main passion is all things vinyl records. Our goal is to create a place for new vinyl listeners and elites alike.

feeds.title: Every record tells a story
feeds.description: Every Record Tells A Story seeks to write about records, and the extraordinary people who made them. ERTAS also features live reviews, photography, the occasional interview and general music-related nonsense.
